# Scroll My Faith

Scroll My Faith (scrollmyfaith.com) is a multilingual, multi-faith scripture discovery website with an endless vertical reading feed.

## What it does
Users can scroll scripture one passage at a time across Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, Judaism, Sikhism and Taoism. Every passage remains clearly attributed to its tradition and translation.

- anxiety

- compassion

Scroll My Faith does not claim different religions teach identical doctrines.
